en.headline: Lee shows blue Five-Year Plan cover ahead of Wednesday release
en.dek: Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address will be issued together on 16 September, with a two-volume summary prepared for the public.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Tuesday displayed the cover of Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan, which he said would be printed in blue to stand for open skies, openness, progress and steadiness.

The Policy Address cover will stay green, Lee said before the Executive Council, to signal continuity, vitality and hope. He described this year's theme as planning the whole picture with a long view and opening a new chapter through reform.

Lee said the two documents together run to about 100,000 words. Officials will present the main points on Wednesday in a briefing expected to last two to three hours, and the government has prepared a two-volume digest of the highlights.

Asked about family-friendly measures, including the HK$20,000 newborn bonus, Lee said a package of related policies would be set out in Wednesday's address and asked the public to wait for the full announcement.

zh.headline: 李家超展示五年規劃藍色封面 施政報告周三一併發表
zh.dek: 特首指《香港第一個五年規劃》封面用藍色，代表開放、進步和穩重；施政報告沿用綠色，兩份文件全文合共約十萬字。
body: 行政長官李家超周二出席行政會議前展示《香港第一個五年規劃》封面，表示會採用藍色，藍色代表藍天，亦代表開放、進步和穩重。
他說《施政報告》封面會沿用綠色，代表政策延續性，亦代表活力和希望。今年理念是「以長遠謀全局、以改革開新篇」，在五年規劃公布後發表首份施政報告。
李家超預告，兩份文件全文加起來約十萬字，政府周三會掖要講述內容，預料兩至三小時完成，並特別製作一套兩冊摘要，介紹重點。
被問及二萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金等生育友善措施，李家超表示明日會有一系列相關政策公布，希望市民稍候完整交代。
